long_biography.plain_text:
Canadian entrepreneur Yuri Fulmer carried a lesson from restaurant work into his investment businesses: owners and boards needed direct access to customer feedback. He sought both individual accounts and measured data, while meeting the managers of portfolio companies to discuss their businesses. His investment approach emphasised defining criteria and the amount of capital at risk before considering opportunities.

With Aart Schuurman Hess, he co-founded Goodly Foods to turn surplus produce into saleable food and create jobs for people facing employment barriers. Chef Karen Barnaby developed its recipes, and the organisation arranged for its soups to reach hospitals, care homes and university cafeterias.

With Aart Schuurman Hess, he co-founded Goodly Foods to turn surplus produce into saleable food and create jobs for people facing employment barriers. Chef Karen Barnaby developed its recipes, and the organisation arranged for its soups to reach hospitals, care homes and university cafeterias.
